closes_when: In frames 10, 12 and 14 the whole head, ears and face stroke rise and tilt up together by a few pixels and return in frames 11, 13 and 15, while the face stroke angle stays consistent between neighbouring frames.
protect: The exact c.png construction (octagon head, zigzag spines, curled tail, leg shapes, stroke weight); the frame 1 close crop and the frame 1-5 pull-back and leftward settle that match the film's camera move; the steady held pose through frames 5-16 with no redraws or doubling.
